generation: Market-unit generation: one market per (reserve, asset), quoted in a factory-minted unit named by the owner's asset approval, with float yield paid to staked liquidity providers through a per-market LpRewardDistributor. Replaces the buyback generation wholesale; nothing from the 2026-09-14 deployment is reused except the Arbitrum Sepolia sUSDai hub, which was repointed rather than redeployed.
sourceCommitNote: Deployed from the working tree during the application migration; the contracts are the ones committed in 'Pay market float yield to LPs instead of buying back the asset'.

remote.hubNote: Carried over from the previous generation. The hub is a UUPS proxy holding the sUSDai position, so a home redeploy repoints its homeReceiver rather than replacing it; redeploying would strand that position.

assetApprovals.note: The owner's approval carries everything economic about a market. Creating one is permissionless and carries nothing: a creator picks an approved asset and an approved reserve, and is recorded only for attribution.

market.creator: 0xeA6Af6c49cdf4654bCC72007d2095121BB2812A9
market.stakedNote: The seeded position is held by the deployer and is NOT staked. Until a full-range position is staked in the distributor it earns swap fees only, and a sweep has no one to pay.

rewards.rewardTokenNote: The market's own unit. Float yield is swept as the unit and streamed to staked liquidity, and an LP may claim in any brand of the same reserve.
rewards.splitNote: protocolBps is 0 on this testnet, so the whole float goes to liquidity providers. lpBps is always 10000 - protocolBps; there is no third leg.

strategyGroups.note: The primary USDC-backed reserve and the Across-bridged sUSDai reserve. Both are approved on the factory, so a market may be opened against either.

approvedReservePools.note: The factory's default reserve; always usable and deliberately not in the approval mapping.
Approved after the deploy: DeployBaseSepoliaPlatform registers the sUSDai group in the registry but never calls setApprovedReservePool, so the factory refused a market on it until this transaction.

libraries.note: Pinned with --libraries. Forge otherwise deploys a linked library out of band, which moves the deployer's nonce outside the plan it simulated.

supersedes.note: That stack's markets, brands (solUSD, MOON, BUKUB) and pools still exist on chain and remain readable, but nothing in this repository points at them. Its factory answers a Market struct with buybackEngine and lockbox where this generation has lpDistributor, so the two cannot share an ABI.
